隐私政策

生效日期：2026 年 10 月 2 日 · 适用平台：iOS / Android / HarmonyOS
本应用不收集、不存储、不上传任何个人数据

「兔时笺」（Rabbit Clock，下称"本应用"）非常重视您的隐私。本应用不收集、不存储、不上传任何个人数据。

本应用访问的网络

本应用仅在以下时机与您选择的时间服务器通信，用于时钟校准：

  • 打开「时间源」页面、切换时间源、开启悬浮显示或回到前台时（10 分钟内不重复）
  • 内置时间源为：中国国家授时中心（ntp.ntsc.ac.cn）、阿里公共 NTP，以及淘宝、大麦、京东、美团、拼多多、云闪付的公开时间接口

通信内容仅为标准时间查询（NTP/HTTP），不包含任何可识别您身份的信息，服务器也无法将请求关联到您。

本应用存储的数据

所有设置（样式、时间源选择、校准结果、计时记录）仅保存在您的设备本地（系统偏好存储），卸载即删除，不会同步或备份到任何服务器。

权限使用说明

  • 通知：仅用于倒计时到点提醒，内容不经过任何服务器
  • 画中画（iOS）：用于悬浮显示时间
  • 悬浮窗（Android / HarmonyOS）：用于悬浮显示时间
  • 后台音频（iOS）：仅为维持画中画悬浮显示的系统要求，不播放可听内容

儿童

本应用无年龄限制（4+），不面向儿童收集信息——因为本应用不收集任何人的信息。

联系方式

对本政策有疑问，请联系：support@example.com

变更

如政策变更将在本页面更新并修改生效日期。

Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 2, 2026 · Platforms: iOS / Android / HarmonyOS
This app does not collect, store, or upload any personal data

Rabbit Clock (“this app”) takes your privacy seriously. This app does not collect, store, or upload any personal data.

Network access

The app only communicates with the time servers you choose, solely for clock calibration, in these situations:

  • When you open the Time Source page, switch time sources, enable floating display, or return to the foreground (no more than once every 10 minutes)
  • Built-in sources: National Time Service Center of China (ntp.ntsc.ac.cn), Alibaba Public NTP, and public time endpoints of Taobao, Damai, JD, Meituan, Pinduoduo, and UnionPay

Communication consists of standard time queries (NTP/HTTP) only and contains no information that can identify you; the servers cannot associate the requests with you.

Data stored by the app

All settings (appearance, time source selection, calibration results, timer records) are stored locally on your device using system preference storage. Uninstalling the app deletes them. Nothing is ever synced or backed up to any server.

Permission usage

  • Notifications: countdown alerts only; the content never passes through any server
  • Picture-in-Picture (iOS): used to display the floating clock
  • Floating window (Android / HarmonyOS): used to display the floating clock
  • Background audio (iOS): a system requirement to keep Picture-in-Picture alive; no audible content is played

Children

This app is rated 4+ and is not directed at children for data collection — because the app collects no one's data.

Contact

Questions about this policy: support@example.com

Changes

If this policy changes, this page will be updated with a new effective date.
